changeSet.comment: The per-occurrence object of the thirteen functions that carry it (manifest_search_384/768/1024, manifest_qualifying_hits, and the nine route (b) functions) gains bib_year, bib_authors, bib_venue, bib_citation_count, indexed_at and content_type_shown, each built only when the compiled predicate names it; the nine route (b) bodies also answer content_type="" for a document with no type, no format and no row value, as the stage does (nexus-qpt52, RDR-236 Phase 3). Thirteen CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION, signatures and grants kept. No data effect: function definitions only.
